title: Implement generic-prime panelized GEMM improvements
description:
Improve non-Mersenne medium-prime GEMM where delayed reduction is insufficient.

## Amendment — 2026-05-06 (user-approved post-R3)

Criterion #1 is amended for the **GF(32749) at n=64³** cell only: marker `[hard] → [aspirational]`. Empirical basis (`dev/bench_results/2026-05-05-9e12659b-medium-prime-gemm.md` § R3 stable bench): GF(32749) at n=64 measures **10.909 Gop/s** (5-trial median, IQR 0.250) vs **10.927 Gop/s** target (1.5× of fflas-ffpack 7.285 Gop/s). Shortfall: **0.18%** — below the cell's own 2% measurement-precision floor (CI half-width). Architectural cause: K_PANEL=2 for GF(32749) in the `madd_epi16` path forces a u32→u64 drain every 2 chunks (because (32748)² × 2 ≈ 2^31 saturates the u32 accumulator), making ~50% of inner-loop instructions drain rather than MAC; n=64 has no panel headroom to amortize the drain cost.

The remaining 11 in-scope cells (GF(257), GF(8191), GF(32749), GF(65521) at the other n) all PASS [hard] with robust IQR (Q1 above target). Per `CLAUDE.md` § *Success-criterion maturity markers* and Wave-6A precedent (`5cacaec5` GF(251) `[hard]→[aspirational]`), the amendment permits the implementation to ship with the 0.18% shortfall on the single cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard for 11/12 cells; [aspirational] for GF(32749) at n=64³ per amendment above] GF(65521) and other medium-prime rows meet the 1.5x threshold.
- [hard] The implementation preserves existing Mersenne fast paths.
